top_stories.title: Bombay High Court grants bail to Sheetal Tejwani in Rs 1,800-crore Mundhwa land deal case | Legal News - The Indian Express
top_stories.rephrased_article: **Omkar Gokhale**, a journalist for **The Indian Express**, specializes in legal and judicial reporting, particularly focusing on the Bombay High Court and Supreme Court's impact on Maharashtra. His work covers a range of topics including fundamental rights, environmental issues, civil and criminal law, constitutional matters, and governance oversight.  Gokhale is known for his detailed and timely reports on court rulings and observations impacting public bodies like the BMC and the State Election Commission.

top_stories.title: TMC unravels: Inside party MPs’ revolt against Mamata Banerjee | Political Pulse News - The Indian Express
top_stories.rephrased_article: The Trinamool Congress (TMC) is experiencing a significant internal crisis with at least 14 MPs attending a meeting at Union Minister Bhupender Yadav's home, claiming to form a separate bloc aligned with the BJP-led NDA.  **Mamata Banerjee**, the party chief, claims the rebels do not have the support of two-thirds of the MPs. The dissidents, led by **Kakoli Ghosh Dastidar**, claim they have 20 MPs on their side and will formally support the NDA for West Bengal's development.  The rebellion has further weakened the TMC following its defeat in the recent West Bengal Assembly elections.

top_stories.title: India deploys active nuclear warheads: What changed in 2025? | India News - The Indian Express
top_stories.rephrased_article: **Global** security data reveals a strategic shift in the Indo-Pacific as regional powers modernize delivery systems and integrate warheads with active launchers. **The United States**, **Russia**, **the United Kingdom**, **France**, **China**, **India**, **Pakistan**, **North Korea**, and **Israel** possess approximately 12,187 nuclear weapons, with China and India potentially deploying a small number of warheads on missiles during peacetime. **India** is reported to have deployed 12 nuclear warheads, possibly mating some with launchers for deterrence patrols.  The report also notes that **China** is modernizing its nuclear arsenal, and **Pakistan** continues to develop its nascent nuclear triad. These developments raise concerns about nuclear escalation risks.

top_stories.title: 40% of Pak smugglers pushing drugs into Punjab located in Lahore, Kasur | Chandigarh News - The Indian Express
top_stories.rephrased_article: **Pakistan**'s Punjab province has seen over 40% of its drug smugglers concentrated in Lahore and Kasur, forming the primary launchpad for narcotics trafficking into **India**.  The two districts are home to numerous smuggling syndicates operating through drone drops, land routes, and container shipments. The most prominent figure on the list is Shafkat Hussain Butt, a resident of Lahore who allegedly uses hexacopter drones for smuggling across the Amritsar border. He enjoys political protection and is linked to Pakistan's Inter Services Intelligence (ISI).  The network maintains overseas facilitation nodes in Dubai, Australia, and links with Afghan nationals.

top_stories.title: Polymarket and Kalshi Say Influencer Partners Can't Deny Election Results, Actually | WIRED
top_stories.rephrased_article: **Kalshi** and **Polymarket**, two prediction market platforms, have asked influencers to remove posts questioning the results of the Los Angeles mayoral election.  **Spencer Pratt**, a conservative reality television star who lost the election, was among those whose posts were flagged. Both companies have policies prohibiting affiliates from promoting false or misleading information related to elections. The actions come amid growing scrutiny of prediction markets and concerns over their potential for manipulation and insider trading.

top_stories.title: Delhi Confidential: Communication Loss On All Fronts | Delhi Confidential News - The Indian Express
top_stories.rephrased_article: **TMC** MPs Kalyan Banerjee and Dola Sen experienced difficulties making or receiving phone calls at the **INDIA** bloc meeting due to a weak mobile network.  **John Brittas**, a **CPI(M)** MP, questioned **Rahul Gandhi**'s remarks about the Left parties during the Kerala Assembly election campaign while **D Raja**, a **CPI** leader, joined in on the criticism. The event poster announcing an inauguration by **Arjun Ram Meghwal**, the **Union Law Minister**, and **CJI Surya Kant** in London was later found to be inaccurate as **Meghwal** was in India and **Kant** did not participate.

top_stories.title: Could Iran and the US play each other at the World Cup? | Al Jazeera | Al Jazeera
top_stories.rephrased_article: **Iran** and **the US** could potentially face off in a historic World Cup match, marking the first time two warring nations have competed against each other on the global football stage. Al Jazeera's @el.sayyed reports that this unprecedented encounter would be a significant event for both countries.

top_stories.title: Italian prosecutors to probe Israeli minister Ben-Gvir over flotilla abuse | Israel-Palestine conflict News | Al Jazeera
top_stories.rephrased_article: **Italian** prosecutors have launched an investigation into **Itamar Ben-Gvir**, the Israeli minister, for his alleged role in the mistreatment of Italian nationals detained during the interception of a Gaza aid flotilla.  The probe follows similar investigations by **France**, which has barred **Ben-Gvir** from entering its territory and is considering sanctions against him. The **Israeli Prison Service** denies allegations of abuse, while the **European Union** is also considering imposing sanctions on **Ben-Gvir**.

top_stories.title: EU planning to add to $1.5 trillion sanctions hit on Russia | Russia-Ukraine war News | Al Jazeera
top_stories.rephrased_article: The **European Union** is proposing to add 80 new entities and individuals to its sanctions list against Russia, targeting its military industrial complex, human rights violators, and propagandists.  **Kaja Kallas**, the EU's foreign policy chief, stated that these measures aim to further cripple Russia's war economy, which has already lost an estimated $1.2 to $1.5 trillion in value due to Western sanctions. Hungary has also agreed to drop its opposition to a previously contested 6.6-billion-euro fund intended to reimburse countries for arms supplied to Ukraine.  Despite ongoing attacks by Russia on Ukrainian civilians and the threat of further strikes, **Kallas** believes that now is not the time for negotiations with Russia.

top_stories.title: Delhi Confidential: Communication Loss On All Fronts | Delhi Confidential News - The Indian Express
top_stories.rephrased_article: **Leaders** attending the **INDIA** bloc meeting at the Constitution Club of India faced difficulties with weak mobile network, leading to some being surrounded by journalists.  **TMC MPs Kalyan Banerjee** and **Dola Sen** were particularly affected as they sought to make or receive calls amidst media attention regarding the ongoing crisis in their party. Tensions between the **Left parties** and the **Congress** also surfaced during the meeting, with **John Brittas**, a **CPI(M)** MP, criticizing **Rahul Gandhi** for his remarks against the Left parties and questioning the Congress's decision to break its alliance with the DMK.
